name: AuditCodeIntegrity
description: Run the code integrity auditor (lifecycle teardown parity, mock-theater test detection, naming invariants, swallowed exceptions) against a file or directory. Returns structured JSON findings.

target.description: File or directory to audit (default: cwd)

prompt.mandatory_instruction: Run AuditCodeIntegrity on the workspace to check for lifecycle teardown parity, mock-theater tests, naming invariants, and swallowed exceptions.
prompt.available_hint: Audits code integrity (lifecycle parity, mock-theater tests, naming invariants, error handling)
